title: fix(gateway): avoid unused workspace fingerprint reads
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Workspace manifest snapshots load both fingerprint blobs even when the requested operation uses only one or neither.

## User Impact

Workspace operations avoid transferring unused fingerprint data while retaining unchanged-file hash reuse. Production disk and latency savings have not been measured.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing snapshot reader selects the fingerprint needed by scan/probe or archive and returns null for unused fingerprint fields. It keeps the same snapshot, revision checks, source-path hydration and prepared-tree lifecycle.

## Evidence

- Real SQLite baseline regressions fail on `c25ff93b`: materialization returns 3,104 BLOB bytes instead of 32; both scan directions return 172 instead of 102.
- The final selector passes all 10 tests in `local-workspace-cas.test.ts` on the same Blacksmith Testbox (Node 24.22.1, Kysely 0.29.7). Materialization returns 32 bytes, scan/probe return 102, and both directions preserve zero content hashes with fresh memos. Exact manifest bytes/reference after database closure and the suite's repair/GC checks pass. [Remote run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42391150700).
- Independent contract review and local autoreview (P0–P2, complete candidate against `c25ff93b`) found no actionable findings. Autoreview was static; execution proof is the remote run above.
- One hosted ClawSweeper request was admitted for this head but failed to produce a publishable artifact; no hosted verdict is claimed.
- Targeted oxlint (0 errors/warnings), formatting and `git diff --check` pass. The full-index test-budget check passes with the exact 107-line allocation; affected production and all five core test-type stripes pass on the exact PR head. Exact-head [PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42392671410) completed successfully: 44 jobs passed and 29 were skipped, with no failures.

Production delta is +13 lines to preserve the nullable snapshot contract while excluding unused payload. Tests add 107 net lines for the returned-byte and required-reuse regressions, covered by the scoped test-line allocation.
